create_self_distillation_config: create a SelfDistillationConfig instance to configure experimental self-distillation training parameters
configure_generation_params: configure generation and rollout parameters like num_generations, temperature, top_p, and max_prompt_length
set_distillation_loss_params: set self-distillation loss parameters including distillation_alpha, distillation_topk, and distillation_weight
validate_config_constraints: validate SelfDistillationConfig parameters including reward scaling, loss type, and batch size divisibility
configure_online_policy_objective: configure online policy optimization with beta KL coefficient, loss_type, and importance sampling level
